scenarios.title: Normal traffic, good weather
scenarios.story: Clear sky at 1 pm. All three roads are moving normally.

scenarios.title: Heavy traffic, several routes
scenarios.story: 6:10 pm rush hour. Khayaban-e-Jinnah is jammed at the Jinnah signal chowk and the inner streets are also heavy. All three routes are open.

scenarios.title: Heavy traffic, rain, urgent
scenarios.story: It has rained since 12:15 and Khayaban-e-Jinnah is jammed. The order is urgent: it must reach UCP in 15 minutes. The Canal underpass is under water, which the traffic app does not show.
